title: Casually · adv
subtitle: 「非正式地／輕鬆地／隨口地／若無其事地」，究竟是哪一種 casually？
description: 「非正式地／輕鬆地／隨口地／若無其事地」，究竟是哪一種 casually？

words.note: 當 casually 指說話、穿着、互動或場合不正式時最直接；重點是 register / formality，而不是情緒放鬆。
words.example: He spoke informally with the new team members after the meeting.
words.exampleZh: 會議後，他以較非正式的方式和新團隊成員交談。

exercises.original: The manager spoke casually with staff after the formal presentation.
exercises.zh: 正式簡報後，經理以非正式方式和員工交談。
exercises.upgrade: informally · 非正式地；隨意地

options.explanation: carelessly = carelessly 表示粗心，不是說話場合不正式。
randomly = randomly 表示沒有固定順序，與語氣正式程度無關。
informally = 和 formal presentation 形成對比，這裡最自然是 informally。
accidentally = accidentally 表示非故意，句子沒有這個意思。
slowly = slowly 只描述速度，不能表達 informal register。
calmly = calmly 表示冷靜，但仍可能很正式。

exercises.original: Guests were invited to mingle casually before dinner.
exercises.zh: 晚餐前，賓客獲邀以較非正式方式互相交流。
exercises.upgrade: informally · 非正式地；隨意地

options.explanation: randomly = 賓客不是隨機移動的意思。
carelessly = 社交場合不表示粗心。
accidentally = 交流是被邀請進行，並非意外。
informally = mingle + dinner 前社交，重點是不正式，因此 informally 很自然。
solemnly = solemnly 表示莊重，和 mingle 語境相反。
mechanically = 不合自然社交互動。

exercises.original: The teacher asked students to discuss the topic casually in small groups.
exercises.zh: 老師要求學生以較非正式方式在小組中討論主題。
exercises.upgrade: informally · 非正式地；隨意地

options.explanation: formally = 和 small-group casual discussion 相反。
carelessly = 討論不需要粗心。
randomly = 未涉及隨機分組或順序。
accidentally = 不是非故意討論。
informally = 小組自由討論而非正式演說，informally 最精確。
silently = 與 discuss 矛盾。

words.note: 最直接的描述性替換之一，表示動作、態度或互動沒有緊張感、壓力或拘謹。
words.example: She chatted in a relaxed way while waiting for the train.
words.exampleZh: 她等火車時以輕鬆的方式聊天。

exercises.original: She answered the questions casually and smiled throughout the interview.
exercises.zh: 她在面試中以輕鬆的方式回答問題，並一直微笑。
exercises.upgrade: in a relaxed way · 以輕鬆的方式；放鬆地

options.explanation: carelessly = 面試中輕鬆不等於粗心回答。
randomly = 回答不是隨機的。
accidentally = 不合有意回答問題的語境。
in a relaxed way = smiled throughout 顯示放鬆、不緊張，因此 in a relaxed way 最自然。
formally = 可以正式，但 smiled throughout 更支持 relaxed manner。
nervously = 和 relaxed 意思相反。

exercises.original: They talked casually over coffee for nearly an hour.
exercises.zh: 他們喝咖啡時輕鬆交談了近一小時。
exercises.upgrade: in a relaxed way · 以輕鬆的方式；放鬆地

options.explanation: solemnly = 咖啡聊天不是莊重正式場合。
carelessly = 不是粗心說話。
randomly = 不表示談話態度。
accidentally = 交談是有意的。
in a relaxed way = 喝咖啡長時間聊天，重點是輕鬆氣氛。
urgently = 和輕鬆聊天的語氣相反。

exercises.original: He leaned back and spoke casually about his plans.
exercises.zh: 他靠後坐着，以輕鬆方式談自己的計劃。
exercises.upgrade: in a relaxed way · 以輕鬆的方式；放鬆地

options.explanation: hastily = hastily 表示匆忙，和 leaned back 不符。
carelessly = 不等於 relaxed。
randomly = 不合。
officially = 和放鬆姿態相反。
accidentally = 不合。
in a relaxed way = leaned back 是放鬆姿態的直接線索。

words.note: 較少見但可用，表示動作或姿態放鬆、不緊張；自然度通常低於 in a relaxed way。
words.example: He sat relaxedly by the window and watched the rain.
words.exampleZh: 他輕鬆地坐在窗邊看雨。

exercises.original: He sat casually in the garden, reading a newspaper.
exercises.zh: 他輕鬆地坐在花園裡看報紙。
exercises.upgrade: relaxedly · 輕鬆地；從容地

options.explanation: carelessly = 坐姿放鬆不等於做事粗心。
randomly = 不合坐姿描述。
accidentally = 不是意外坐下。
formally = 和 garden leisure 語境不符。
relaxedly = 坐姿和活動都很放鬆，relaxedly 可用，雖然日常更常說 in a relaxed way。
tensely = 意思相反。

exercises.original: She waited casually by the pool with a book.
exercises.zh: 她拿着一本書，在泳池旁輕鬆等候。
exercises.upgrade: relaxedly · 輕鬆地；從容地

options.explanation: impatiently = 和拿書輕鬆等候的畫面相反。
carelessly = 等待方式不是粗心問題。
randomly = 不合。
accidentally = 不合。
formally = 不合泳池休閒語境。
relaxedly = pool + book 表示明顯休閒狀態，因此 relaxedly 可作替換。

exercises.original: He casually stretched out on the sofa after work.
exercises.zh: 下班後，他輕鬆地伸展身體躺在梳化上。
exercises.upgrade: relaxedly · 輕鬆地；從容地

options.explanation: relaxedly = 下班後在 sofa 放鬆，relaxedly 表達姿態很貼切。
formally = 梳化休息不是正式場合。
carelessly = 不表示疏忽。
randomly = 不合。
accidentally = 不是意外動作。
stiffly = stiffly 表示僵硬，和 stretched out 相反。

words.note: 當 casually 指沒有正式儀式、禮節或客套地做某事時可用；有時帶『毫不客氣』或突然感。
words.example: She dropped the files unceremoniously on the desk.
words.exampleZh: 她不拘禮節地把文件放到桌上。

exercises.original: He casually dropped the boxes by the door and left.
exercises.zh: 他不拘禮節地把箱子放在門邊就離開了。
exercises.upgrade: unceremoniously · 不拘禮節地；隨便地

options.explanation: formally = 這個動作明顯沒有正式程序。
carefully = carefully 強調小心，原句沒有這種意味。
randomly = 位置不一定隨機。
accidentally = 他是有意放下箱子。
gracefully = 不符合突然、隨便的動作。
unceremoniously = 直接放下東西就走，沒有禮節或程序，unceremoniously 很自然。

exercises.original: The meeting ended casually when the chair simply stood up and left.
exercises.zh: 主席直接站起離開，會議就這樣不拘形式地結束。
exercises.upgrade: unceremoniously · 不拘禮節地；隨便地

options.explanation: unceremoniously = 沒有正式宣布或程序便結束，unceremoniously 最精確。
solemnly = 沒有莊重結束儀式。
formally = 正好相反。
accidentally = 主席站起離開並非意外。
randomly = 不表示缺乏禮節。
calmly = 可以冷靜，但未表達 abrupt lack of ceremony。

exercises.original: She casually placed the award in a drawer instead of displaying it.
exercises.zh: 她毫不講究地把獎項放進抽屜，而沒有展示出來。
exercises.upgrade: unceremoniously · 不拘禮節地；隨便地

options.explanation: proudly = 和沒有展示相反。
unceremoniously = 對本應有儀式感的 award 毫不講究地處理，unceremoniously 很貼切。
carefully = 未必。
formally = 不合。
randomly = 不表示對獎項態度。
accidentally = 是有意放進抽屜。

words.note: 當 casually 指某句話說得很隨口、沒有太多考慮或重視時最精確。
words.example: He offhandedly mentioned that he might move abroad.
words.exampleZh: 他隨口提到自己可能會移居海外。

exercises.original: She casually mentioned that she might leave the company.
exercises.zh: 她隨口提到自己可能會離開公司。
exercises.upgrade: offhandedly · 隨口地；漫不經心地

options.explanation: offhandedly = mentioned + 重大消息卻說得很隨意，offhandedly 最精確。
formally = mentioned 的語氣不是正式宣布。
carelessly = 可能有疏忽意味，但這裡重點是隨口說。
randomly = 不是毫無關聯地亂說。
accidentally = 她是有意提及，只是很隨意。
solemnly = 和隨口提及相反。

exercises.original: He casually remarked that the project might be cancelled.
exercises.zh: 他隨口說那個項目可能會被取消。
exercises.upgrade: offhandedly · 隨口地；漫不經心地

options.explanation: urgently = 沒有急迫語氣。
offhandedly = remarked 通常可配 offhandedly 表示隨口評論。
formally = 不是正式公告。
accidentally = 不是口誤或意外。
randomly = 內容和談話可能相關。
carefully = 和 offhand remark 相反。

exercises.original: She casually asked whether he was planning to move abroad.
exercises.zh: 她隨口問他是否打算移居海外。
exercises.upgrade: offhandedly · 隨口地；漫不經心地

options.explanation: officially = 私人問題不是正式詢問。
nervously = 原句沒有緊張線索。
offhandedly = 問題本身較重大，但提出方式很隨口，offhandedly 很自然。
accidentally = 問句是有意提出。
randomly = 不表示語氣隨意。
carelessly = 不是粗心提問。

words.meaning: 若無其事地；滿不在乎地
words.note: 表示某人表現得很平靜、像事情並不重要；比 casually 更強調不在意或故作冷靜。
words.example: She nonchalantly shrugged and changed the subject.
words.exampleZh: 她若無其事地聳聳肩，然後轉換話題。

exercises.original: He casually shrugged when asked about the mistake.
exercises.zh: 被問到錯誤時，他若無其事地聳聳肩。
exercises.upgrade: nonchalantly · 若無其事地；滿不在乎地

options.explanation: anxiously = 和若無其事相反。
nonchalantly = shrugged 面對 mistake 顯示像不在乎，nonchalantly 最貼切。
carelessly = 可以有不在意感，但不如 nonchalantly 精確表達態度。
formally = 不合 shrug。
accidentally = shrug 是有意反應。
randomly = 不表示態度。

exercises.original: She casually continued eating while everyone else reacted to the news.
exercises.zh: 其他人都對消息作出反應時，她卻若無其事地繼續吃東西。
exercises.upgrade: nonchalantly · 若無其事地；滿不在乎地

options.explanation: urgently = 和 continued eating 的平靜感相反。
nervously = 沒有緊張線索。
nonchalantly = 大家反應強烈而她像沒事一樣，nonchalantly 很精確。
formally = 不合。
randomly = 不合態度描述。
accidentally = 吃東西不是意外。

exercises.original: He casually walked away after making the surprising announcement.
exercises.zh: 他作出驚人宣布後，若無其事地走開。
exercises.upgrade: nonchalantly · 若無其事地；滿不在乎地

options.explanation: solemnly = 未表示莊重。
hurriedly = 沒有匆忙線索。
carefully = 不合。
nonchalantly = 驚人消息之後仍表現得毫不在意，nonchalantly 比 general casually 更強。
accidentally = 不合。
randomly = 不合。

words.note: 當 casually 指以不急促、慢悠悠的節奏做某事時適用；常形容 walking, eating, browsing 等。
words.example: They walked leisurely along the waterfront.
words.exampleZh: 他們悠閒地沿海濱散步。

exercises.original: They casually walked through the park after lunch.
exercises.zh: 午飯後，他們悠閒地在公園散步。
exercises.upgrade: leisurely · 悠閒地；不慌不忙地

options.explanation: hurriedly = 和悠閒散步相反。
randomly = 不是路線無規律的意思。
leisurely = 公園飯後散步強調不急不忙的節奏，leisurely 最自然。
carelessly = 不表示步行方式。
formally = 不合公園散步。
accidentally = 不合。

exercises.original: She casually browsed the market stalls on Sunday morning.
exercises.zh: 星期日早上，她悠閒地逛市場攤檔。
exercises.upgrade: leisurely · 悠閒地；不慌不忙地

options.explanation: urgently = 市場閒逛沒有急迫感。
carelessly = 不是粗心查看商品。
randomly = 不是隨機選攤檔。
leisurely = Sunday morning + browsing market 表示悠閒節奏。
officially = 不合。
accidentally = 不合。

exercises.original: We casually ate breakfast on the terrace before leaving.
exercises.zh: 出發前，我們悠閒地在露台吃早餐。
exercises.upgrade: leisurely · 悠閒地；不慌不忙地

options.explanation: hastily = 和 leisure pace 相反。
carelessly = 用餐悠閒不等於粗心。
randomly = 不合。
formally = 未有正式餐會語境。
leisurely = terrace breakfast 強調慢悠悠的活動節奏，leisurely 很貼切。
accidentally = 不合。

words.note: 當 casually 指某人舉止自然、不做作、不刻意正式時可用；比 informally 更偏自然流露。
words.example: She smiled naturally for the photograph.

exercises.original: She casually laughed with the children during the photo shoot.
exercises.zh: 拍攝期間，她和孩子們自然地笑。
exercises.upgrade: naturally · 自然地；不拘束地

options.explanation: formally = 笑容不是正式程度問題。
carelessly = 不合自然表情。
randomly = 不合。
naturally = 拍照時不做作、自然流露的笑最適合 naturally。
accidentally = 笑可能自然，但不是意外。
stiffly = 和自然放鬆相反。

exercises.original: He casually joined the conversation without seeming awkward.
exercises.zh: 他自然地加入談話，一點也不顯尷尬。
exercises.upgrade: naturally · 自然地；不拘束地

options.explanation: officially = 不合社交加入。
carelessly = 不是粗心。
randomly = 不表示社交流暢度。
accidentally = 他不是誤打誤撞加入。
naturally = without seeming awkward 明確支持 natural manner。
mechanically = 和 without seeming awkward 相反。

exercises.original: The actor casually delivered the line as if it were ordinary conversation.
exercises.zh: 演員把台詞自然地說出，就像普通對話一樣。
exercises.upgrade: naturally · 自然地；不拘束地

options.explanation: formally = 和 ordinary conversation 不符。
randomly = 不合表演方式。
carelessly = 自然表演不等於粗心。
accidentally = 台詞是有意說出。
dramatically = 原句正是在避免過度戲劇化。
naturally = as if it were ordinary conversation 表示自然、不做作，因此 naturally 最精確。

words.note: 較正式的描述性說法，表示沒有典禮、繁瑣程序或正式禮節。
words.example: The two sides met without formality to discuss the issue.
words.exampleZh: 雙方以非正式方式會面討論問題。

exercises.original: The two leaders met casually over breakfast.
exercises.zh: 兩位領袖在早餐時以不拘形式的方式會面。
exercises.upgrade: without formality · 不拘形式地；非正式地

options.explanation: secretly = 未表示秘密會面。
randomly = 會面不是偶然排列。
carelessly = 不適合外交／領導人會面。
accidentally = 不是意外碰面。
without formality = 領袖會面但沒有正式程序，without formality 很清楚。
ceremonially = 和 without formality 相反。

exercises.original: The award was presented casually before the meeting began.
exercises.zh: 獎項在會議開始前以不拘形式的方式頒發。
exercises.upgrade: without formality · 不拘形式地；非正式地

options.explanation: solemnly = 會增加莊重儀式感。
randomly = 不表示形式。
carelessly = 頒獎非正式不等於粗心。
accidentally = 頒獎是有意安排。
privately = 未必是私人場合。
without formality = 沒有正式典禮地頒發 award，without formality 最自然。

exercises.original: They agreed casually to continue the discussion the next day.
exercises.zh: 他們不拘形式地同意翌日繼續討論。
exercises.upgrade: without formality · 不拘形式地；非正式地

options.explanation: without formality = 如果重點是沒有正式程序或儀式，這個描述最清楚。
legally = 沒有法律程序線索。
accidentally = agreement 是有意的。
randomly = 不合。
carelessly = 不表示協議形式。
solemnly = 過於莊重。

words.note: 當 casually 指說話語氣像日常交談、不正式、不像演講或正式書面語時很自然。
words.example: The presenter spoke conversationally rather than reading from a script.
words.exampleZh: 講者以談話式語氣說話，而不是照稿朗讀。

exercises.original: The speaker explained the technical idea casually rather than giving a formal lecture.
exercises.zh: 講者以談話式語氣解釋技術概念，而不是作正式講授。
exercises.upgrade: conversationally · 以談話式地；隨和地

options.explanation: academically = 會更像正式學術講授。
carelessly = 簡單易懂不等於粗心。
randomly = 不合語氣。
accidentally = 不合。
solemnly = 不合談話式風格。
conversationally = rather than giving a formal lecture 明確支持 conversational delivery。

exercises.original: She casually talked the audience through the process.
exercises.zh: 她以談話式語氣向觀眾逐步解釋流程。
exercises.upgrade: conversationally · 以談話式地；隨和地

options.explanation: conversationally = talked the audience through 本身就帶互動、談話式風格。
mechanically = 會表示僵化、缺乏自然互動。
carelessly = 不等於 casual speaking style。
randomly = 流程說明不應無順序。
officially = 太正式。
accidentally = 不合。

exercises.original: The podcast host spoke casually, using everyday language.
exercises.zh: 播客主持人以隨和談話式語氣說話，使用日常語言。
exercises.upgrade: conversationally · 以談話式地；隨和地

options.explanation: formally = 和 everyday language 相反。
conversationally = using everyday language 是 conversational style 的直接線索。
carelessly = 日常語言不等於粗心。
randomly = 不表示 register。
accidentally = 不合。
ceremonially = 不合 podcast 語境。

falseSynonyms.zh: 粗心地不等於 casually carelessly 表示沒有足夠注意或小心，常帶負面意味；casually 可以只是非正式或放鬆，未必粗心。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Casual behaviour can be relaxed without being careless.

falseSynonyms.zh: 隨機地不等於 casually randomly 表示沒有固定模式或選擇依據；casually 描述態度、方式或正式程度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Randomly describes selection or order; casually describes manner.

falseSynonyms.zh: 意外地不等於 casually accidentally 表示不是故意的；casually 不表示動作是意外發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON An accidental action is unintended; a casual action may be deliberate.

falseSynonyms.zh: 慢慢地不一定等於 casually slowly 只描述速度；casually 可以快速但仍然非正式或隨意。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Casually is about manner or attitude, not simply speed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 冷靜地不完全等於 casually calmly 強調沒有激動；casually 還可表示非正式、隨口或不拘禮。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Someone can speak calmly but still very formally.

falseSynonyms.zh: informally 只涵蓋部分 casually informally 重點是正式程度；casually 還可能表示漫不經心、若無其事或悠閒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Informally is about formality; casually has several other shades of meaning.

falseSynonyms.zh: 副詞與形容詞不同 casually 是副詞，修飾動作；casual 是形容詞，修飾人、衣着、場合或態度。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She dressed casually. She wore casual clothes.

falseSynonyms.zh: 方式與穿着描述不同 casually 可修飾很多動作；casually dressed 特別表示穿着休閒。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He spoke casually. He was casually dressed.
